parameters.name: sop
parameters.label: SOP
parameters.description: Reference to a SOP that will have its geometry converted to POP geometry.

parameters.name: polygons
parameters.label: 5+ Points Polygons
parameters.description: How to handle polygons with 5 or more points: Ignore, Triangulate, or create Closed Line Strip.

parameters.name: mesh
parameters.label: Meshes
parameters.description: How to convert mesh primitives: Quads, Rows/Cols to Line Strips, or Point Primitives.

parameters.name: inputcolorspace
parameters.label: Input Color Space
parameters.description: Override or set the color space for incoming geometry colors.

parameters.name: inputreferencewhite
parameters.label: Input Reference White
parameters.description: Color space reference white for incoming data: SDR, HDR, or UI brightness.

parameters.name: bypass
parameters.label: Bypass
parameters.description: Pass through the first input to the output unchanged.

parameters.name: freeextragpumem
parameters.label: Free Extra GPU Memory
parameters.description: Free memory that has accumulated when output memory has grown and shrunk.

parameters.name: delinputattrs
parameters.label: Delete Input Attributes
parameters.description: Only output which attributes you specify — helps isolate attributes into a separate branch.

useCases: Import FBX/OBJ/Alembic meshes for GPU-accelerated noise displacement and particle emission
Convert SOP point clouds to POP pipeline for real-time rendering and simulation
Transfer SOP UV, color, and normal attributes to POP shaders via attribute renaming
Convert mesh topology to point primitives for volumetric particle emission sources
SOP boolean/subdivision results → POP noise deformation for live visuals

examples.name: Mesh Disintegration

examples.name: Mesh Point Cloud Emitter
examples.description: SOP Sphere → SOP to POP → Delete POP (Random 50%) → Particle POP (birth from points)

examples.name: UV-Driven Texture Sampling
examples.description: SOP with UV → SOP to POP → Lookup Texture POP (sample video texture)

commonCombinations: SOP to POP → Noise POP (GPU displacement on imported meshes)
SOP to POP → Delete POP (random point culling for density control)
SOP to POP → Particle POP (mesh-surface particle emission)
SOP to POP → GLSL POP (custom vertex/pixel shaders on SOP geometry)
SOP to POP → Attribute Convert POP (type conversion for downstream ops)

troubleshooting.solution: CPU→GPU PCIe transfer cost is inherent. Minimize data by reducing SOP point count or using fewer attributes.
Check SOP has the attributes. Delete Input Attributes toggle strips everything not explicitly kept.
Set Input Color Space explicitly instead of Automatic — especially for ACES or HDR workflows.
5+ point polygons default to Triangulated. Change menu to Closed Line Strip or Ignore as needed.
Check Meshes menu — Rows to Line Strips preserves different topology than Convert to Quads.

description: Converts SOP 3D geometry to POP geometry across the CPU→GPU boundary. Transfers point/vertex/primitive attributes with automatic renaming (uv→Tex, Cd→Color, width→LineWidth, pscale→PointScale). Handles triangles, quads, meshes, and NURBS with configurable conversion menus for 5+ point polygons and mesh topology.
